record.question: Consider the following statements about the Indian Freedom Struggle: (i) The Indian National Army was founded in 1942. (ii) The Indian National Congress adopted the resolution of Purna Swaraj or complete independence in 1929. (iii) The Second Round Table Conference was held in 1931. How many of the above statements are correct?
record.explanation: Answer C: All the three statements. All three statements are correct: the INA was founded in 1942, Purna Swaraj was adopted at Lahore in 1929, and the Second Round Table Conference met in 1931. Reference: https://www.britannica.com/topic/Indian-National-Army; https://www.constitutionofindia.net/historical-constitution/assembly-debates/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: October 2025 examination (cover page); answer time-sensitive wording as of then.. Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
